mechanism: Keep one embodied first-person observer continuous while a subject attempts several visible concealments. Each intervention must expose a deeper, independently readable contradiction; camera height and proximity change only through the observer's body, and the payoff is a visible turn from active concealment to stopping the concealment and settling back into the workstation state rather than another reveal.

invariants.rule: Use one continuous embodied first-person observer whose height and distance changes come from physical movement.
invariants.purpose: Makes discovery feel participatory and spatially honest.
invariants.ablation_failure: Third-person cutaways break the inspection logic.

invariants.rule: Require at least two concealment attempts that each expose a deeper contradiction.
invariants.ablation_failure: Random reveals do not form a proof ladder.

invariants.rule: Keep every evidence layer spatially nested inside one stable work area.
invariants.purpose: Lets viewers understand how each object hid the next.
invariants.ablation_failure: Geographically unrelated clues feel edited rather than discovered.

invariants.rule: Hand off from object proof to a sustained facial or bodily reaction.
invariants.purpose: Converts evidence into a social consequence.
invariants.ablation_failure: Ending on a screen leaves the human payoff unresolved.

invariants.rule: End with a visible behavior change rather than a third reveal.
invariants.purpose: Provides a distinct acceptance or refusal state.
invariants.ablation_failure: Continuous escalation without a state change has no closure.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: source revealing wardrobe and body framing
